# Fremont Aikido

Fremont Aikido is a nonprofit Aikido dojo in Fremont, California. It offers adult, teen, youth, and Daito-Ryu training.

## Core facts

- Address: 43210 Christy Street, Fremont, CA 94538, United States
- Phone: +1-510-738-6375
- Email: FremontAikido@gmail.com
- Status: 501(c)(3) nonprofit, Tax ID 47-2042734
- Adults and teens: Monday 7:00–8:30 PM (advanced students), Tuesday 7:00–8:30 PM, Thursday 6:30–8:00 PM, Saturday 10:00 AM–12:00 PM
- Children and teens: Tuesday and Thursday 5:30–6:30 PM, Saturday 9:00–10:00 AM. Children ages 7–12; teens ages 13–17.

## Training focus

Training develops aerobic conditioning, balance, coordination, awareness, calm decision-making, safe partner practice, and practical self-defense foundations. Aikido is a defensive martial art; the dojo does not promise shortcuts or encourage conflict.
